title: Understanding the Gradient Descent Update
text:
In stochastic gradient descent, the update rule for a parameter \( $$	heta$$ \) is given by:

\( 	heta**{(t+1)} $$=$$ 	heta**{(t)} - \alpha \cdot 
abla L(	heta**{(t)}) \)

where \( \alpha \) is the learning rate and \( 
abla L(	heta**{(t)}) \) is the gradient of the loss function with respect to \( $$	heta$$ \).

title: Calculate the Gradient for \( $$\theta_1$$ \)
text:
To find the gradient for \( $$	heta_1$$ \), substitute \( $$x_i=2$$ \), \( $$	heta_0=4$$ \), and \( $$	heta_1=1$$ \) into the gradient expression:

\(  rac{\partial L}{\partial $$	heta_1$$} $$=$$  rac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}**{n} \left(- rac{x_i}{	heta_1} + $$	heta_0$$ $${x_i}^2$$ + $$	heta_0$$ ight) \)

Calculate this value for the given \( $$x_i$$ \).

title: Substitute Values into the Gradient Expression
text:
Substitute \( $$x_i=2$$ \), \( $$	heta_0=4$$ \), and \( $$	heta_1=1$$ \) into the gradient expression for \( $$	heta_1$$ \):

\(  rac{\partial L}{\partial $$	heta_1$$} $$=$$ - rac{2}{1} + $$4$$ \cdot $$2^2$$ + $$4$$ \)

Calculate this expression to find the gradient value.

title: Determine the Learning Rate
text:
Using the update rule for \( $$	heta_1$$ \):

\( 	heta_1**{(1)} $$=$$ 	heta_1**{(0)} - \alpha \cdot 
abla L(	heta_1**{(0)}) \)

Substitute \( 	heta_1**{(1)} $$=$$ $$-5$$ \), \( 	heta_1**{(0)} $$=$$ $$1$$ \), and \( 
abla L(	heta_1**{(0)}) $$=$$ $$18$$ \) to solve for \( \alpha \).
